NFC (Near Field Communication) coin cards and tags are compact and versatile tools that allow for wireless communication between devices over short distances. Whether embedded within a 3D-printed object or attached externally, these tags can store information such as print settings or model data, making the final product more interactive and easier to manage.

The magnetic connector is an electronic component that utilizes the principle of magnetism to achieve connection. It consists of a male part and a female part. When in use, the male and female parts will automatically attract and connect together due to the magnetic force when they are close to each other, thus enabling the transmission of signals or electricity.

strings.en: The Magnetic Levitation DIY Kit features an innovative design that uses magnetic technology to make objects float smoothly in mid-air. Consisting of a base, float, and power supply, this kit creates a futuristic, tech-inspired ambiance, perfect for DIY enthusiasts eager to design custom desktop decorations. From floating collectible figures and moon lamps to unique 3D-printed pieces, your imagination is the only limit.

Catmaw AFV is a 1/10 scale model car. Its prototype is Uro Vamtac. It can be used as a display car or installed on a remote-controlled car chassis like SCX10 III (AXI03011). It has 4 working doors, a rear hatch that can be opened and folded down, and modular design for the rear part. It also has some internal features and can be customized with additional components.

strings.en: The Motion-Activated Sound and Light Props Kit is a versatile multi-functional set designed specifically for handheld props, integrating lighting, sound, and motion control to deliver a personalized immersive experience. The high-brightness LED strips with diffused pearl cotton provide smooth, natural lighting effects, while the built-in speaker ensures clear sound quality. Equipped with an IMU motion sensor, it captures real-time movements, triggering corresponding lighting and sound effects, such as turning on/off with rotation.

strings.en: This Decoration & Display Kit includes Plastic Button Ornaments For Shoe Charms, Split Ring Keychains, Reclosable Fastener Mounting Tape, Magnet Stickers and Eye Bolts with Self-Tapping Threads, making it ideal for creating personalized shoe decorations, home displays, keychain customizations, and more. It offers flexible solutions for various needs. Whether for home organization, creative decoration, or personalized customization, this set opens up a world of possibilities.

This kit is specifically designed for creators who love making motorized models. It includes 030 DC motors, reduction gear kits, power distribution board set, battery spring contact plate, and Y type wire, making it an ideal power and drive system for your motorized models.

The Easy Mounting Kit is a versatile mounting solution designed to effortlessly attach your creative projects to various smooth surfaces. The kit includes high-quality suction caps, double-sided tape, and reclosable fastener mounting tape, allowing you to secure models to refrigerators, tiles, cabinets, or other slick surfaces at any time. When used in combination with 3D-printed models, these components make mounting decorative or functional items more convenient and flexible. Whether you need a stable and strong hold or a way to easily move and reposition your creations, the Easy Mounting Kit has you covered.

This Dynamic Installation Art Kit is designed to help creators and art enthusiasts create exquisite interactive art pieces or dynamic mechanical devices, such as automata devices, tourbillon models, marble run models, and rotating display stands.

The Desktop Ornament Components Kit is designed to bring endless possibilities and personalized creativity to your tabletop. The kit includes a wide variety of electronic and mechanical parts that can be easily assembled with 3D-printed models to create different styles of desktop decorations.

This Filament Protection Kit includes 12 packs of desiccant, 2  thermometer hygrometers, and 1 roll of adhesive foam sponge strip roll, effectively preventing filaments from being damaged by humid environments. The components in the kit can replace expired desiccants in the AMS and add standalone hygrometers. Additionally, they can be used to modify multiple filament storage boxes, providing a safer storage environment for opened filaments.

This kit includes a variety of commonly used self-tapping screws, machine screws, and corresponding nuts in different specifications and lengths, meeting the fastening needs of various models and structures. From self-tapping screws for small-sized holes to machine screws and round threaded brass heat-insert nut for larger components, this set provides highly adaptable and secure connections for diverse applications.

It's time to give your 3D printing workshop an upgrade with the Workshop Modification Kit! This kit contains medium sized bearings, a thermometer hygrometer, LED light strips, magnets, pneumatic fittings, desiccant, adhesive foam sponge strip and silicone tube. Whether you need to make your own filament spool winder, drybox, AMS stand, hanging light, tool box or temperature and humidity monitoring kit, this kit will provide you with the parts you need to create the most impressive workshop.

The Stainless Steel Eye Bolt with Self-Tapping Thread offers a practical and versatile solution for enhancing the functionality of 3D-printed models. Their unique design—featuring a circular loop and a threaded shaft—makes them ideal for integrating mechanical, decorative, and structural capabilities into printed objects.

Making elaborate miniature models of tourbillons, gearboxes, engineering machinery and bionic toys only to find that the strength, stiffness, tolerance and smoothness of the printed shaft system are not up to expectations? This Precision Shaft System Kit contains multiple sizes of miniature deep groove ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, bronze bushings and pins, which help to solve the strength and accuracy problems in designing the shaft system and linear motion of small-sized models. Take your miniature model to the next level.

This kit contains a Bluetooth Remote and a USB controller. We have prepared this replacement kit for RGB LED Strip Light and S-shape LED Strip Light (WS2812B RGB) to cover any possible loss or damage during the crafting process.

Imagine having your own mini-factory at home, where you can create one-of-a-kind masterpieces! This accessory pack is your secret weapon. Packed with a variety of components, including buzzing motors, clicking gears, and warm candle lights, it's ready for you to unleash your creativity and assemble amazing models.
